description: This file defines a React hook named useLocalPhases that manages phase items with CRUD-like operations backed by localStorage. It facilitates adding, updating, removing phases, and computes phase status statistics.

methods.name: useLocalPhases()
methods.description: Main hook providing state management and CRUD operations for phases stored in localStorage.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new phase item to a specific phase ID with provided details.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates an existing phase item identified by itemId within a specific phase.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a phase item identified by itemId from a specific phase.
